patterns: Single most repeated item (UPSC 2013, 2021, state PSCs): creation of new money is the most inflationary way to finance a deficit.
Purpose recall: in India deficit financing raises resources for economic development (UPSC 2013 twice; APPSC).
APPSC G1 asks the character of deficit financing (inflationary) and the Indian meaning (borrowing from RBI).
Definition item: fiscal deficit = budgetary deficit + net increase in internal and external borrowings (1994).
App MCQs add FRBM / ad hoc T-bill history and AP debt data, deeper than PYQs but sound.
